title: Quaint Flaky Croatian Fish Dumplings
description: A traditional Croatian dish featuring fish dumplings steamed in a flavorful peach juice broth, infused with herbal notes of parsley and dill.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, melted butter, eggs, parsley, dill, salt, and pepper, and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a piece of cod fillet in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the fish to form a dumpling and press the edges together to seal.
In a large steamer basket, arrange the dumplings in a single layer, leaving some space between each dumpling.
Pour peach juice into the steamer and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low, cover the steamer, and steam the dumplings for 10 minutes.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with additional parsley and dill if desired.
